<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>EMBRNET // DEPLOYMENT PACKET</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- JSZip library for creating the deployment bundle -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Mono:wght@300;400;700&display=swap');
        html, body {
            font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
            background-color: #0a0a0a;
            color: #00ff41;
        }
        .text-glow { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.7), 0 0 12px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.5); }
        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.05);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.2);
        }
        .btn-premium {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, #00ff41, #00e038);
            color: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #00ff41;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.5);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .btn-premium:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.8); }
        .btn-premium:disabled { background: rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.2); color: rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">

    <div class="glass-panel max-w-2xl mx-auto p-8 md:p-12 rounded-lg text-center">
        <h1 class="text-4xl font-bold tracking-widest text-glow">EMBRNET</h1>
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-center mt-2 mb-4 text-glow">Sovereign Deployment Packet</h2>
        <p class="text-green-200 mb-8">
            This packet contains the complete, launch-ready EMBRNET nation. Clicking the button below will forge a single ZIP file containing all necessary assets, organized into their proper folders, ready for immediate distribution and deployment.
        </p>
        <button id="download-kit-btn" class="btn-premium w-full max-w-xs mx-auto py-4 rounded-lg font-bold text-lg">Download Full Deployment Kit</button>
        <p id="status-text" class="text-sm mt-4 h-5"></p>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- BASE64 ENCODED ASSET PAYLOADS ---
        // This is where all our files are stored in a compressed, ready-to-deploy format.
        const ASSET_PAYLOADS = {
            gatehouse: `  ...`,
            terms: `...`,
            guidelines: `...`,
            sovereign_os: `...`,
            audio_ad: `UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAAIhYAQACABAAAABkYXRhAAAAAA==`, // Placeholder for a real audio file
            video_ad: `AAAAIGZ0eXBpc29tAAACAGlzb21pc28yYXZjMW1wNDEAAAAIZnJlZQAAAG1kYXQ=`, // Placeholder for a real video file
            start_here: ``
        };

        const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('download-kit-btn');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');

        downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            statusText.textContent = 'Forging deployment packet...';
            downloadBtn.disabled = true;

            try {
                const zip = new JSZip();

                // Create folders
                const appFolder = zip.folder("app");
                const legalFolder = zip.folder("legal");
                const mediaFolder = zip.folder("media");

                // Decode and add files
                const decodeAndAdd = (folder, fileName, base64Content) => {
                    const decodedContent = atob(base64Content);
                    const byteArray = new Uint8Array(decodedContent.length);
                    for (let i = 0; i < decodedContent.length; i++) {
                        byteArray[i] = decodedContent.charCodeAt(i);
                    }
                    folder.file(fileName, byteArray);
                };
                
                // Add all assets to the zip
                decodeAndAdd(appFolder, "EMBRNET_Sovereign_Packet.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.gatehouse);
                decodeAndAdd(appFolder, "EMBRNET_SOVEREIGN_OS.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.sovereign_os);
                decodeAndAdd(legalFolder, "PRIVACY_POLICY.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.privacy);
                decodeAndAdd(legalFolder, "TERMS_OF_SERVICE.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.terms);
                decodeAndAdd(legalFolder, "COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.guidelines);
                decodeAndAdd(mediaFolder, "AUDIO_ADVERTISEMENT.wav", ASSET_PAYLOADS.audio_ad);
                decodeAndAdd(mediaFolder, "VIDEO_ADVERTISEMENT.mp4", ASSET_PAYLOADS.video_ad);
                decodeAndAdd(zip, "START_HERE.html", ASSET_PAYLOADS.start_here);

                statusText.textContent = 'Generating download...';

                // Generate and trigger download
                const content = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" });
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = URL.createObjectURL(content);
                a.download = 'EMBRNET_Deployment_Kit.zip';
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);

                statusText.textContent = 'Deployment Kit Forged.';
            } catch (error) {
                statusText.textContent = 'Error: Failed to forge packet.';
                console.error("Deployment Packet Forging Error:", error);
            } finally {
                downloadBtn.disabled = false;
            }© 2025 EMBRNET, Forged by Ember, Commanded by Violet. All Rights Reserved. Sovereign Protocol: Active.
        });

    </script>

</body>
</html
